obligations.title: Checked shape and cardinality
obligations.property: For every accepted shape, cardinality equals the mathematical product; zero extents yield zero before irrelevant intermediate multiplication, and all exported machine-size results fit their target type.
obligations.scope: Verus proves structural arithmetic; Kani checks the shipped finite-width checker over symbolic dimensions without allocating those dimensions.
obligations.non_vacuity: Positive scalar and nonzero shapes plus zero-times-large extents; mutate the zero-first and overflow checks.

obligations.title: Structural index and origin maps
obligations.property: Checked reshape, transpose, permutation, gather and rank maps select exactly the modelled source cells, preserve required bits/validity/origin and never permit out-of-bounds access.
obligations.scope: Generic sequence/cell proofs plus bounded executable mapping and machine-width checks; unsafe pointer refinements need separate audit/Miri evidence.
obligations.non_vacuity: Nonempty rectangular values, null cells and repeated legal gathers; mutate a stride, domain generation or permutation uniqueness check.

obligations.title: Empty-frame schema inference
obligations.property: The schema rule computes frame ++ output-cell shape without invoking an absent cell; empty cells follow the operation-specific policy.
obligations.scope: Prove the schema relation; count actual kernel calls in bounded cases.
obligations.non_vacuity: [0,3] rows(mean) has zero calls, [3,0] errors, [0,3,4] rank-2 transpose yields [0,4,3]; no first-cell sampling.

obligations.title: Graph meaning and preparation refinement
obligations.property: Each public builder denotes its documented operation; preparation and admitted rewrites preserve values, validity, permitted errors, guards and effects under explicit kernel contracts.
obligations.scope: Verus establishes local semantic/refinement rules; Kani checks bounded graph compositions and executable guards. Rust macro correctness also needs compile/UI checks.
obligations.non_vacuity: Shared host expression executes once; intentionally change flow ordering or move a fallible node across its guard.

obligations.title: Outcome and frame contracts
obligations.property: Success returns the modelled value; specified inputs/resources/termination conditions imply success; failure or pre-commit cancellation preserves the output frame promised by the selected atomic API.
obligations.scope: State safety separately from termination/progress. Verus proves sequential state/frame invariants; Kani explores bounded errors and commit transitions.
obligations.non_vacuity: Reach successful commit and error/cancellation paths; always-Err, early-write and duplicate-commit mutations fail.

obligations.title: Typed higher-order application
obligations.property: For each applicable active valid cell, the caller supplies the callable precondition; every output allowed by its postcondition satisfies the lifted relation. Inactive cells never invoke it.
obligations.scope: Use call_requires/call_ensures-style universal postcondition reasoning and typed executable bindings; captures/effects/termination remain explicit.
obligations.non_vacuity: Nonempty active and inactive cells, faulting inactive input and a consumer-defined kernel; rejecting eager select must not rely on an all-false mask.

obligations.title: Reducer histories and numeric policies
obligations.property: Accumulator state relates to precisely the processed input history; finalization/merge preserves the declared order, null, empty, overflow and frame contract.
obligations.scope: Prove traversal/association and integer checks. IEEE bit/policy reasoning is distinct from real arithmetic or transcendental accuracy.
obligations.non_vacuity: Right subtraction 9 versus left 5, singleton -0, MAX grouping, wrong-count finalizer and unapproved merge mutations.

obligations.title: Partition invariance
obligations.property: Partitioned native execution preserves the logical snapshot, ordered neighbourhoods, prefix state and segment ownership regardless of physical chunk boundaries.
obligations.scope: Verus proves partition composition for owned kernels; Kani checks bounded halos/segments. Upstream backend conformance remains separate.
obligations.non_vacuity: One-cell and awkward chunks, zero extents and empty segments; omit a halo or reset prefix state at a chunk boundary.

obligations.title: Conservative staged cost analysis
obligations.property: The shared analyser never understates the abstract quantity it claims to bound; static/preparation/runtime evaluations agree for equal facts and target profiles.
obligations.scope: Verus proves cost-expression and admission soundness; Kani checks finite-width overflow and branch outcomes. No theorem about elapsed time or untracked backend allocation.
obligations.non_vacuity: Exact, interval and unknown examples including 4096^2 F64, zero products and cross-width overflow; mutate upper/lower direction or unknown handling.

obligations.title: Schedule checking and resource admission
obligations.property: Every admitted owned schedule satisfies its shape/guard/index and tracked-live-allocation obligations, or halts before the next forbidden reservation, assuming the recorded kernel contracts.
obligations.scope: Prove the small checker, not planner optimality. Scope the theorem to named buffers, scratch, metadata and permitted concurrency.
obligations.non_vacuity: Admit a small allocation then reject next growth; omit halo, reuse stale schedule identity or conflate aliased handles with distinct allocations.

obligations.title: Backend eligibility and effect control
obligations.property: A backend capability becomes eligible only under compatible tested semantics, engine and control scope; strict no-spill admission never relies on unenforceable per-query controls.
obligations.scope: Verify owned capability and policy checking; explicitly trust/test upstream execution. Python version and documentation alone do not constitute Rust conformance evidence.
obligations.non_vacuity: Attempt Python-only capability admission, deterministic-fallible speculation, stale backend cache and concurrent global-control mutation.

obligations.title: Consumer proof composition
obligations.property: Separate downstream crates establish application properties through shipped public views, lemmas, contracts and comb! without private symbols, alternate proof executors or assumed whole-engine specifications.
obligations.scope: Verus verified dependencies and Kani public executable/contract harnesses retain precise implementation identity and scope.
obligations.non_vacuity: Run correct and incorrect application fixtures; fake trusted executor and private-method stubs cannot satisfy acceptance.

obligations.title: Witness applicability
obligations.property: Selections, permutations, validated views and resource witnesses apply only to their bound extent/domain/policy/immutable generation; rebinding re-establishes changed facts.
obligations.scope: Prove applicability and frame conditions; executable checks protect unverified safe callers, including interior-mutability or generation boundaries.
obligations.non_vacuity: Same-length different source, stale generation and partial validity cases fail; legal reuse against unchanged bindings succeeds.

obligations.title: Proof compatibility and evidence binding
obligations.property: An accepted proof record identifies the property, executable/specification, target, toolchain, scopes and trust basis; relevant changes invalidate dependent evidence and released specification changes follow explicit compatibility policy.
obligations.scope: Typed binding and dependency verification support semantic review; hashes identify artefacts but do not prove correspondence.
obligations.non_vacuity: Strengthen a precondition, weaken a postcondition, swap a compiled body or import stale verification metadata; dependent gates fail.
